about_the_game:
Feria 3000 is a high-intensity action roguelite set in a neon-drenched Andalusian fairground of the future.

Step into the Feria de Abril in the year 3000, where flamenco tradition collides with rogue artificial intelligence. You play as a relentless flamenco heroine fighting to survive against endless waves of cybernetic enemies, supported by powerful companions and driven by a living, reactive soundtrack.

Combat is fast, aggressive, and skill-based. Precision shooting rewards clean headshots, while slow-motion jumps give you precious time to reposition when chaos erupts. Every encounter pushes you to master movement, timing, and spatial awareness as enemy patterns grow more complex and unforgiving.

At the core of each run are your companions. They fight by your side, shape your build, and fundamentally alter the flow of combat. But they do more than deal damage — each companion adds a unique musical layer to the soundtrack. Vocals, basslines, breaks, and acid loops are triggered dynamically, assembling a procedural breakbeat track that evolves in real time as you play.

No two runs sound the same.
No two builds feel the same.

Between encounters, you choose how your run evolves. Power-ups enhance damage, movement, survivability, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Every decision matters, encouraging experimentation and mastery across repeated sessions.

Visually, Feria 3000 blends Andalusian cultural iconography with cyberpunk excess. Lanterns glow under neon light, breakbeat rhythms echo through steel structures, and tradition decays into something violent, surreal, and electric.

Runs typically last between 15 and 30 minutes depending on skill and build choices, offering a tightly paced experience built for replayability, discovery, and high-score chasing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / Intel Arc A580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT / Intel Arc B580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
